description: This file provides utility functions for processing energy dataset previews: parsing dates and numeric values, converting energy units to kWh, and processing raw preview rows into structured, normalized data suitable for further analysis. It defines data classes, helper functions, and a main processing function.

classes.name: ProcessResult
classes.description: Immutable data class encapsulating processed dataset, summary, and preview rows.

methods.name: Optional[float] _parse_float(value: Any)
methods.description: Converts various string or numeric inputs to float, handling formatted strings with commas.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _parse_datetime(value: Any)
methods.description: Parses various date/time string formats into timezone-aware UTC datetime objects.

methods.name: Optional[float] _to_kwh(value: Optional[float], unit: EnergyUnit)
methods.description: Converts energy values from units ('w', 'kw', 'kwh') into standardized kWh.

methods.name: ProcessResult process_dataset_from_preview( *, preview_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], date_column: str, usage_column: str, usage_unit: EnergyUnit, region_column: Optional[str] = None, max_rows_store: int = 50_000, )
methods.description: Main function to normalize and process a set of preview rows, parsing dates, converting energy units, and filtering invalid rows.
